title: Site Migration QA & Broken Link Checker input

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Required. One URL per line. In "list" mode these are the URLs to check (for a migration: your old URLs). In "sitemap" mode each line is a sitemap URL, or a site whose sitemap is found through robots.txt or /sitemap.xml. In "crawl" mode each line is the page where the crawl starts. https:// is added when missing; duplicates are removed. At most "Max URLs" unique URLs are checked.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How to use the start URLs. list (default): check exactly the URLs given. sitemap: read the sitemap(s) first and check every URL listed in them. crawl: open each start page and follow same-site links up to "Max crawl depth", recording the source page and anchor text of every link.

maxPages.title: Max URLs
maxPages.description: Safety cap on how many unique URLs are checked in one run. Whole number from 1 to 100000, default 1000. URLs beyond the cap are not checked.

maxDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxDepth.description: Crawl mode only; ignored in the other modes. How many link levels to follow from the start page. Whole number from 0 to 10, default 3. 0 checks only the start page, 1 also checks the links found on it.

checkExternal.title: Check external links
checkExternal.description: Crawl mode only. When on, links that point to other sites are also checked for status, but those pages are not crawled. Default off.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many requests run in parallel. Whole number from 1 to 20, default 5. Requests to the same host are still spaced out, so the Actor stays polite to the sites it checks.

respectRobots.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobots.description: When on (default), URLs that the site's robots.txt disallows for this Actor are not requested; they appear with category robots_blocked. Turn off only for sites you own or may test.

debugNetwork.title: Debug network
debugNetwork.description: Optional, default off. Logs connect details of failed requests (host, attempt, reason, error classes) to the run log. Never logs headers, bodies, paths or query strings.

description: Paste the URLs to check (for a site migration, your old URLs), choose a mode and click Start. Each URL is requested and its redirects are followed one hop at a time, so every row shows the final status and the redirect chain.
